LESSON.headline: the sweep found THREE swaps; only ONE was previously known, and one row had been explicitly recorded as CLEARED.
LESSON.on_extrapolation: the run-support differential does NOT predict the probability move. CWS@MIN carried a differential 70% as large as LAD@DET's (0.8221 vs 1.1704) and moved 1.14pp against 11.75pp — an order of magnitude less. Team form and park dominate and the differential partly cancels. Estimating the impact from the differential would have overstated CWS@MIN roughly sevenfold. Compute it.
LESSON.on_flagging: every row flagged during the 8/28 cycle resolved immaterial or already-correct. All three swaps found here came from rows nobody was watching. The flag was tracking SOURCE CONFLICT; the defect is SILENT AGREEMENT on a reversed pair, which by construction produces no conflict to notice.
LESSON.on_the_control: the convention was re-validated against a known-correct row BEFORE any swap was claimed. Three simultaneous swap claims from a mis-applied half-inning rule would have been worse than the defect.
